links.outcome: Independent reproduction of a proprietary opioid risk score's reported performance on real-world datasets
links.effect: Models built from the documented feature set, with added socioeconomic covariates and multiple ML architectures, all performed well below reported benchmarks on California PDMP and IQVIA PharMetrics Plus data.
links.quote: Despite reconstructing the documented feature set, adding socioeconomic covariates, and rigorously evaluating multiple supervised machine learning architectures, all models performed well below reported benchmarks.

screen.reason: Evaluates the reproducibility, validity, and algorithmic opacity of the proprietary NarxCare opioid risk predictive model on real-world datasets, raising safety and regulatory concerns.
